ios.desc:
AllsOK is a simple daily check-in app for anyone living alone, seniors, or caregivers. Set a time, tap the AllsOK check-in button, and if you miss it, the app will automatically notify your trusted contact. It's peace of mind, made easy.

HOW IT WORKS

Set Your Daily Check-In Time: Choose the best time to receive your daily notification.

Press the ‘I Am Okay’ Button: When notified, simply tap the button to let your trusted contact know you’re fine.

Automatic Alerts: If you don’t check in within an hour, AllsOK will notify your trusted contact via WhatsApp, Email, or both, prompting them to check on you.

KEY FEATURES

Easy Setup: Get started in just a few taps—set your time and enter your trusted contact’s details.

Flexible Alert Options: Choose to send alerts via WhatsApp, Email, or both for maximum reliability.

Reliable Notifications: Receive daily reminders to check in at your specified time.

Peace of Mind: Know that your loved one will be alerted if you can’t respond.

WHO SHOULD USE ALLSOK

Seniors Living Alone: Enhance your safety and let others know if you’re not okay.

Individuals with Dependents: Essential for single parents, pet owners, and anyone with dependents who worry about their well-being.

Students Living Alone: Offers peace of mind to families knowing their loved one is safe while away at school.

DOWNLOAD AND TRY ALLSOK FOR 30 DAYS FOR FREE Join the community of users who trust AllsOK for their daily safety check-ins. It’s easy and effective!

SUBSCRIBE Purchasing a subscription gives you access to the daily check-in service and updates for 12 months. The subscription purchase will be applied through your iTunes account on confirmation. Your annual subscription will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime in your iTunes account settings.

With a subscription, you’ll continue to receive:

Daily Check-In Reminders – Never miss a check-in.

Automatic Alerts – Ensure your trusted contact is notified via WhatsApp or Email if you don’t check-in.

Reliable Peace of Mind – Stay safe and reassure your loved ones every day.

Stay safe, stay connected, and ensure all’s okay, every day with AllsOK!

Your usage of this app constitutes agreement to the Terms of Use found here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

*IMPORTANT* WhatsApp alerts are only available to paid subscribers and not during the trial.
